name: craftsman-marketplace
description: Engineering-readiness audits for AI-built apps: a Claude Code and Codex marketplace with practical, opinionated craft skills.

plugins.name: craftsman
plugins.description: Ship something with Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, Claude Code, or Codex and it works, but nobody with an engineering background has checked it before real customers arrive. craft-audit reviews the whole project the way a senior engineer would, across ten areas: not just security, but the database rules that keep one customer's data separate from another's, whether the money path is tested, and whether errors get seen before a customer has to report them. Findings are plain language, ranked by real consequence, so a broken invoice check beats a missing comment, and written to a workspace in your project so a long audit can pause and resume. The companion skill craft-fix drives the repairs but can never mark its own work fixed; only a fresh audit pass confirms that. A full worked example is included, so you can see exactly what it finds before you run it. Not a penetration test, not continuous monitoring, no numeric score.
